headline: Iran's foreign minister leaves Pakistan, then Trump cancels U.S. delegation's travel
summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi left Islamabad after arriving on Friday. President Trump said envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will no longer travel there Saturday for peace talks.
why: Diplomatic efforts between Iran and Western governments shape the risk premium on Middle East energy supply and regional shipping routes. Investors track these talks for signals on sanctions and conflict escalation.
